interview.secured: The app never explained "Day secured" to me; the home screen only showed a streak of 0 days and 'Day 1 starts now', so my guess is that it means I've submitted proof for today, but that's a guess.
interview.freeze: I never saw a freeze explained in what I looked at, so I can't say what it is; I'd only guess it protects a streak if I miss a day.
interview.selfReported: The app never defined "Self-reported" for me, so I'm only guessing that it means I said I did the task and nobody verified it.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - The streak and week tracker plus the one-glass-of-water task is simple and fits how I check my numbers, but the terms weren't explained and the feed looked empty and black, so I'm not fully sold.

goals.text: You have used GRIIT for about a month. Open your profile and scroll through every one of your posts to the end. Then go to Home and compare the numbers: does the streak and the day number on Home match what your profile says? Say in your thought every number that does not match.
